brief: 策略自走棋手游 UI 套件:主菜单 / 对战棋盘 / 棋子详情 / 羁绊图鉴 / 结算,横屏 1920x1080。

pages.role: Main menu — brand area + player info, big start-matchmaking entry, secondary entries (piece codex / synergy codex / shop), resource bar.
Match board — eight-player health/rank bar, own board + bench, shop refresh area (gold/level/interest), synergy activation panel.
Piece detail — piece portrait, star tier, skill description, owned synergies, combine hint.
Synergy codex — synergy list with activation tiers/effects and related pieces.
Result — final placement, comp recap, rating change, play-again/back entries.

styleAxes.mood: 幽蓝战棋大厅:深石板暗底 + 符文金描边,庄重策略感,棋盘格清晰、信息层级分明。
styleAxes.accent: 主符文金 #F2C14E + 青晶 #4FD6C9 + 紫晶 #A878F0,稀有度梯度(灰/绿/蓝/紫/金)用于棋子边框与星级。
styleAxes.type: 无衬线粗体大标题表达庄严策略感;数字(金币/等级/血量/利息)使用大号粗体强调资源对比。
styleAxes.density: 横屏分区栅格:顶部信息条 + 中部棋盘/列表 + 侧栏面板,中高密度;圆角卡片 + 细描边,自绘皮肤控件统一调性。
